correctness.rationale: For all lengths and every comparison signed walk, table P(g,abs(d)) is nonnegative with P(0,0)=0. Exhaustive symbolic integer substitution in 216 symmetry-reduced states with |d|<=8 and an analytic bound for every |d|>=9 verify 3g_next -5|d_next| + P_next <= P_current, which telescopes to the claimed 5/3 bound. The explicit (1,1,3,1)(2,3,1)^r family proves sharpness. Current-file verifier replays the 408 signed transition cases, independent exact DP on all 29523 short words, and 501 witness values.
